coverage_notes.summary: Twelve targeted searches covered sole/only/last/full-service grocery loss, canceled or suspended emergency food distributions, abrupt pantry or food-bank service closure/reduction, and immediate SNAP/WIC/food-assistance interruption. No new U.S. event in the bounded hourly window met the qualifying criteria.
exclusions_observed: Older Eastport, Maine only-grocery-store closure reporting outside the hourly window.
Kauaʻi emergency food distributions were proceeding as scheduled, not canceled or suspended.
Older, non-U.S., or non-immediate SNAP, WIC, pantry, and food-bank results.
Routine recovery, promotion, volunteer, and generic policy or funding coverage.
coverage_notes.source_priority: Fresh local news, official/provider notices, and direct source pages were prioritized.
coverage_notes.production_authority_note: This supplementary recall watch is non-authoritative; production collection remains authoritative.
